quest.title: Candidature Analysis
quest.description: Yelan does not seem particularly reassured by Zhiyi and decides to go down to the wharf to speak to Bolai and find out how well he is rated by others.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Mora x34075, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Go to the North Wharf to look for Bolai

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Look, your asking price for this batch is just too high. I can't buy in at this price. How am I supposed to turn a profit?

dialogues.speaker: Qiping
dialogues.text: Come on, hear me out. I'm telling you, this is the single best batch of Sunsettias ever. You won't find anyone who disputes that.

dialogues.speaker: Qiping
dialogues.text: I accidentally dropped one into a well, and even the water turned sweet!

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Even so...

dialogues.speaker: Qiping
dialogues.text: Shhh, alright, alright, I'll let you in on a little secret. The boss of Second Life also wants to buy from me, but I haven't responded yet.

dialogues.speaker: Qiping
dialogues.text: If you won't take them, I'll just have to partner with them instead, and neither of us wants that.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Okay, well, when you put it that way... I'll accept your asking price. I'll take all your stock. Don't sell a single one to Second Life!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The trader who was negotiating with Bolai leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Oh, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: And to be clear, these Sunsettias are mine. I got to them first, don't get any ideas!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, we want to ask you about a guy called Zhiyi. Have you heard of him before?

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Zhiyi? Yes, he's quite well-known.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: I've heard a story about him. They say he was born into poverty, his parents died when he was young, and he was treated cruelly by the local community.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: One of his neighbors was terribly rude to him all the time, but Zhiyi never retaliated — and when his neighbor went bankrupt, he even helped support the family.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: He returned cruelty with kindness, injustice with peace offerings... A gentleman of talent and character and— Oh... how did I not notice him sooner? In fact, maybe I'm not too late. If I could hire him to be the brand ambassador for Wanyou Boutique...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He sounds like a decent man! We can finally breathe a sigh of relief!

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Why are you asking about him, anyway? You aren't... looking for a brand ambassador too, are you?

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Well then, in that case, the higher bidder takes the... Hmm? Ah, that's Zhiyi right over there. Why don't we go and talk to him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where, where?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #It's him alright. Looks like he's chatting with Linlang, {NICKNAME}... Come on, let's follow them and listen in.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Try not to let him see you. We want this information to be as truthful as possible.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: I'll just go and fetch an employment contract... And hey, don't try and cut me out of this! Heeey!

choices.text: I've got more than enough in my bag...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Try not to let him see you. We want this information to be as truthful as possible.

talks.objective: Listen to Zhiyi and Linlang chat

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Zhiyi seems to get along really well with everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you satisfied now, Yelan? Seems like everyone thinks Zhiyi's a great guy.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We shouldn't jump to conclusions just yet. Let's go check out the wharf where he usually goes fishing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, do we have to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're not just trying to dig up some dirt on Zhiyi because you wanna be Tianshu yourself, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Maybe I am, maybe I'm not. But hey, if I do become Tianshu, I'll look out for you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You'll be able to try all the finest food for free. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We will!? Well come on, off to the South Wharf we go!

talks.objective: Go and check the South Wharf

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The wharf is as busy as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I hear the anglers here sometimes sell their fish to the nearby fishmongers. Hmm, let's see what Uncle Sun has to say.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Welcome, what would you like to buy today?

choices.text: We're here to ask you about someone.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Sorry to interrupt. We're actually members of the, uh... Liyue Anglers Association, and we just wanted to ask a few questions about someone.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: We've heard about this young man called Zhiyi who's supposed to be a fantastic fisherman. Just wondering if you happened to have heard of him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... Yelan made up a whole fake identity without batting an eyelid...

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: Ah yes, Zhiyi. He's been making quite a name for himself recently. I've got some friends who travel all over the place, and they tell me everywhere they go they meet someone who's heard of him.

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: Apparently, he had a rather tough time growing up. Had to work several jobs alongside his studies to make ends meet.

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: How does that saying go — what doesn't kill you makes you stronger? Well, if there's anything to that logic, he's sure to be phenomenally successful one day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we think so, too!

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: But I'm afraid your Anglers Association might be in for a disappointment.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh, why's that?

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: He's good at a lot of things, but fishing isn't one of them. He fishes at the wharf, and sells what he catches to me on occasion.

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: His catches are always mediocre. Not terrible, but equally nothing to write home about. If you're looking to recruit some new members, though, I do know a few top anglers I could put you in touch with...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: That sounds fantastic. I've got a couple of other things to attend to right now, though, so... why don't I come back some other time, and we can chat over a drink?

response.speaker: Uncle Sun
response.text: Sure thing. See you!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: "Everywhere they go, they meet someone who's heard of him." Hmm... C'mon, let's keep asking around.

choices.text: We're here to buy some... information.

talks.objective: Continue looking for clues at the wharf (0/2)

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Here to buy some fish? It's 300 for one or 3 for 1,000!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: You better hurry, when they're gone, they're gone!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hello, we're from the Society for Fish Price Research. We'd just like to ask a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... She switched identity again...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Society for... Fish Price Research? I haven't done anything illegal, stay out of my business!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Please don't worry, we're just here to conduct a simple survey.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We've heard about a certain Zhiyi who's been selling fresh fish at low prices in this area recently. Do you know anything about this?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: So this isn't about me. You should have said something, you know. I know the guy, I can tell you what I know.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: I haven't heard anything about him selling fresh fish at low prices, but it wouldn't surprise me if it was him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Because he's so poor. His parents died when he was very young and his alcoholic father still owed a huge amount of debt. No one wanted to have anything to do with him.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: He was still a kid when he first came to the wharf. His clothes were ragged, and he had a bandage wrapped around his head.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: He managed to survive thanks to Uncle Tian, who gave him some food. But still, to this day, he doesn't have a lot of Mora to his name.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: I mean, he can afford to eat and everything, but you'll often see him haggling with others over just a few Mora. So I wouldn't be surprised to find out he's been selling a few fish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: It's not like he catches much anyway, so it's not going to affect my business. Oh... Don't tell him I said that.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You'd rather he didn't know?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Well... I spoke to him once, briefly, and I just had a feeling that he really cares what other people think of him.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: I think he has pretty low self-esteem... But hey, it's hardly my place to say anything. What he's achieved already puts most people to shame.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Nobody's perfect. I just wouldn't want to upset him, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I see. Well, thank you for sharing that with us.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Not a problem. And just for the record, there's absolutely nothing wrong with the price of my fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The more times you say it, the less convincing it becomes...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: "Doesn't have a lot of Mora to his name"... Okay, let's keep going.

talks.objective: Continue looking for clues at the wharf (1/2)

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Hey, it's you guys. Wait, what's the phrase... Oh yeah, "Honored to meet you!"

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: What brings you to me?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The truth is, we are but newcomers to this territory. We heard tell of a great martial artist, Master Dugu, who knows everything there is to know. Hence, we sought you out to ask for your guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: R—Really? People said... I know everything there is to know?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But of course. We also heard that Master Dugu is a kind and virtuous swordsman who never turns away anyone who comes with questions.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Great... Ahem, so, what do you wish to know? Nothing happens on this street that I don't know about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Now she's lying to a kid!

choices.text: But it seems to have made his day...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So, Master Dugu. Have you heard of one by the name of Zhiyi?

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Sure have! You mean that guy that all the grownups are talking about these days?

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: ...I've heard many tales of Zhiyi. For example... um... I can't remember...

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Probably 'cause it's nothing that important. I prefer stories about sword-fighting heroes!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh, I can completely understand that. Then let me ask you this... Do you remember roughly when the grownups started talking about Zhiyi?

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Ooh, yeah, I know that! It was about two or three months ago!

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Before that, people always used to talk about Zhiyi in a kinda nasty tone of voice... but two or three months ago, suddenly everyone started to like him.

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Sometimes, he gives me candies. So I'm glad that people are starting to like him now!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Just as I thought...

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Huh? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I mean, just as I thought, Master Dugu is indeed as kind and virtuous as the legends claim.

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Heh... I'm not THAT great...

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Oh yeah, one other thing. These days, there's a lot of people I've never seen before talking about Zhiyi's stories in the street. They seemed like nice people.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh, definitely.

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Great! So next time I see them, I'll say hi! And... I guess I can share some of my candies with them, too.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Certainly! You can also tell my friend in Yanshang Teahouse about what they're up to. I'm sure my friend would also like to say hi to them.

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Thank you, Ma'am!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You're welcome! Well then... Fare thee well, Master Dugu.

response.speaker: Dugu Shuo
response.text: Until we meet again!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Any of that sound strange to you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Strange? What was strange about it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Zhiyi seems to have a great reputation. Uncle Sun and Uncle Gao spoke highly of him, and Dugu Shuo seems to like him, too...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: True, but the issue is... where did his sudden celebrity come from? It almost seems too good to be true.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sudden? Too good to be true? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So he returns cruelty with kindness, and had to work to support his studies... These are the kinds of things that make someone well-known in their hometown. But Uncle Sun said even his friends who travel far and wide hear about him wherever they go. That's a little over the top, if you ask me.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Do you remember what Dugu Shuo said about Zhiyi's stories? Clearly they left him with a good impression of the guy, but beyond that he wasn't interested in the details. That's the reaction I would expect from any normal person.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Plus there's the fact that all this praise of Zhiyi has only been happening within the last two or three months.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: His childhood, his studies, the thing with his neighbor... None of these are recent events. So why are these stories only going around now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When you put it like that, it is kinda strange...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Of course, if that's all there was to it, I wouldn't look into it any further.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Zhiyi was born into a poor family. Paying people to get his stories out there is within the rules of the game, as far as I'm concerned.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The problem is... do you remember what Uncle Gao said about him? He's stayed poor his whole life. Everything he's earned, he's either spent on studying, traveling, or paying off debts. I don't think he has the Mora to pay for a publicity campaign.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Right, and that changes everything... It could mean a powerful faction is trying to gain influence over the Liyue Qixing.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: That's the worst-case scenario, but all too often, the most pessimistic speculation turns out to be the closest to the truth.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Someone's trying to gain influence over the Qixing? That sounds serious. What should we do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if we asked Zhiyi about it, surely there's no way he'd admit it.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: First we need to find out who's supporting him... Don't worry, I've got a plan.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Remember the Current Affairs and Planning stage of the assessment? Since the successful candidate is duty bound to implement their plan after taking office, their manifesto tells us their stance on key issues.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Whoever is secretly helping Zhiyi must be seeking to benefit from his actions after his appointment. So we should be able to find some hints in Zhiyi's manifesto on who we're dealing with.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Come on, let's get back to Yanshang Teahouse.

choices.text: I guess it's a white lie...

talks.objective: Go back to Yanshang Teahouse and check the manifesto

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Zhiyi's manifesto covers a huge range of topics. Looking for details that don't add up will be like trying to find a needle in a haystack.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll divide the reports into two piles. You take one, I'll take the other. When we're finished, we'll put our heads together.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Officially, the assessment is already over, and I'll be expected to announce the results before long. So we have to get to the bottom of this as quickly as we can.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! We'd better hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Whatever else Uncle Tian might think of Zhiyi, the fact remains that he's one of his favorite students.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Any evidence he's left is not going to be immediately obvious. We'll have to look carefully, and think critically.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stop reading.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All this reading is giving Paimon a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's take a break.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Aha, looks like I'm the first one back, as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, it's one of Yelan's little helpers, Shanghua!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you're back, that means... that means you've finished investigating Qianwei, right?

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: You betcha. I visited all the commerce guilds and gathered a wealth of information. Every time they asked me to leave, but I always had another trick up my sleeve...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't drag this out. Just tell us your findings.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Yes, Lady Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: To summarize my findings, most people who've had interactions with Qianwei will start out complaining about how proud and arrogant he is, but then go on to give a generally positive appraisal of him.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: The young master of the Feiyun Commerce Guild said that Qianwei appears arrogant, but he's very scrupulous in the way he works.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Once he signs a contract with somebody, he treats them fairly regardless of their background.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who'd have thought!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Is it possible that his reputation is fake? Is there any way you can check the accounts of the businesses under his name?

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: In theory, that should be very difficult. But here's the thing... I asked around and found out that almost all of Qianwei's accounts are open to the public.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Where he buys from and sells to should be confidential business information, but he doesn't seem interested in protecting it at all.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Qianwei often sees business opportunities that others don't. But once he's made enough Mora off of it, it's like he gets sick of it and releases all of his trade secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: It's like he wants people to know that they still can't beat him even if he shares all of his secrets. The fact that someone like that can still make Mora is pretty infuriating when you think about it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a strange guy. It's like he's not doing business to make Mora, but instead...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: To validate his theories. No wonder his manifesto contains so many insights — it's all the result of his firsthand experimentation.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: I'm back... Huh? How come you're here?

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Why do you think? Obviously, because I possess superior skills and am always one step ahead of the competition... Well, when you're the competition, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: You... Whatever, I'm not getting into an argument with you. If I hadn't had something else to take care of on the way, I would've been back long before you.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: Lady Yelan, I have finished investigating Mingbo.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, we're all ears.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs says that Mingbo struggles to get his words out when he gets nervous, especially when he's chatting with strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: But after a few days of getting to know him, you can pretty much have a normal conversation with him. On the whole, the feedback from the Ministry of Civil Affairs was very positive. He always considers the things that everyone else overlooks.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In your opinion, was the Ministry of Civil Affairs' appraisal of Mingbo at all exaggerated?

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: I don't believe so. Mingbo is someone who has slowly but surely earned the reputation he has today.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: According to Ms. Yu, the Ministry often gets Mingbo to take a final look at projects before they're implemented. People feel much more confident in something if it has his stamp of approval.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: Oh, and also, there was once someone in the Ministry who was lying and cheating to try to advance their career. Mingbo gave them the scolding of a lifetime. Apparently, he can be terrifying when he loses his temper... I haven't seen it for myself though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... That's hard to imagine...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Like I said before: Things are not always as they appear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's what you meant by that. Paimon's starting to get it now...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Thank you both. You're free to go now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #So, have you finished reading the manifesto, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We still have a bit left, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You finish reading the manifesto with Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm... I can't see any immediate problems looking at the individual entries.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The only one that strikes me as a little unusual is the Qingxu Pool Redevelopment Plan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Qingxu Pool has always been home to many secrets. Plus, Azhdaha once wrought havoc there, so there are even more secrets buried deep underground.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: At some point, a rumor began to go around that there is great treasure buried beneath Qingxu Pool.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: A long time ago, with the approval of the Qixing, a mining team conducted an exploratory excavation there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... did they find any treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: None. The ruin was completely impenetrable. The only way they could have gotten through the solid rock would've been by blowing it open with a special kind of explosive.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The technology wasn't mature enough at that time, so the excavation project was shut down, and the "treasure" became a mere legend.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Zhiyi's manifesto focuses on solving problems, and this treasure hunt seems extremely risky. It seems out of step with the rest of his plans.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Still, this one fact alone doesn't tell us much. Everyone wants to get their hands on this treasure — the Treasure Hoarders, the Fatui, even local Liyue factions...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #"Excavation," "project," "treasure"... Did we read anything similar in our half of the manifesto, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah! Zhiyi said the Blackcliff Forge workers should get right of first refusal if any suitable projects come up!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Did he now? Well, that makes everything much clearer... So Zhiyi wants the Blackcliff Forge to excavate the treasure of Qingxu Pool.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean the Blackcliff Forge is Zhiyi's secret supporter?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: No, not likely. I've looked into the Blackcliff Forge before. They aren't involved with any powerful factions at present.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: They do possess some specialized explosives, but it would seem more trouble than it's worth to put so many resources into a risky project like this.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Still, since the clues are pointing toward the Blackcliff Forge, we should see where they lead. We may well find something new.

talks.objective: Go to Blackcliff Forge to investigate
Go to Blackcliff Forge to search for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sooooo... anything strange been going on recently?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: ...Excuse me? What's that supposed to mean, strange how?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh... just... y'know, stuff that when it happens, you think to yourself: "That was weird!"

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I don't think we're going to get anywhere asking questions like that. Let's just take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? A diary?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: From the back, it looks like a ledger. But it seems they also use it as a site log.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We don't know who wrote it, but it's interesting, don't you think? These newcomers... Who could have sent them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You think they're suspicious?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yes. Look, it says right there: one of them's already been promoted to team leader.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: At this rate, by the time the Qingxu Pool Redevelopment Plan is ready to roll, they'll be the technical backbone of the team.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That'll give them the chance to take a lot of liberties... They can copy any secret texts or steal any treasure they find underground.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Imagine if we didn't suspect anything. By the time Zhiyi recommends the Blackcliff Forge for the excavation project, at most we would maybe do a fresh background check on the place.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No red flags if all they did was change some key staff. And even if we decided to vet the staff individually, they'd have had more than enough time by then to come up with fake identities.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That's the advantage of planning this far in advance... It was a clever move.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you put it like that, it all makes sense... If we hadn't found this out, someone else would've stolen the treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So who's really behind all this?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That's a question for the newcomers. But let's start with that worker over there for now.

talks.objective: Talk to Iron Shoulder about the newcomers at the forge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, excuse us... We wanna ask you about the newcomers!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: *sigh* You want them to teach you or something?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: I gotta say, these newcomers are in tip-top shape. Fast learners, too. They're picking up all the skills unbelievably fast.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: My only complaint is that they're always going out drinking at night, but they never let us join them.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: I guess they just need some time to adjust. I'm sure we'll get to know each other over time.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: They go out drinking? This area isn't exactly renowned for the nightlife. I'm guessing it's a long trip to the nearest tavern?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: You got that right. They tell me they go all the way back to Liyue Harbor to drink at Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: It rained after work today, so they actually stuck around at the site for a while. But as soon as the rain stopped, they went out drinking again right away.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: Hey, you're only young once, right? I say, if they can hack it, let 'em at it, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #Interesting. Let's go talk somewhere else, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Yelan takes you to a quieter place...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Looks like our hunch was on the Mora. These newcomers are very suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Drinking in Liyue Harbor, huh? Some cover story. I'll wager they've been going to intelligence updates...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good thing it rained today — it means they'll leave footprints... I doubt they'd give themselves away that easily, but let's follow them and try our luck.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The footprints stop here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But judging from the direction, I'm guessing their destination was that abandoned house.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Traces
dialogues.text: (It looks like there may have been a fight here, but it's hard to say for certain.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Traces
dialogues.text: (This was the work of a professional... but who?)

dialogues.speaker: Fruit Pit
dialogues.text: (A fresh fruit pit. Someone was here recently.)

dialogues.speaker: Fruit Pit
dialogues.text: (There don't seem to be any more clues.)

dialogues.speaker: Compacted Mud
dialogues.text: (These stripes in the dirt were likely made by a bamboo mat. That means someone slept here.)

dialogues.speaker: Compacted Mud
dialogues.text: (But the bamboo mat is nowhere to be seen now.)

dialogues.speaker: Burned-Out Fire
dialogues.text: (A fire that burned out. Something was burned here not long ago.)

dialogues.speaker: Pile of Leaves
dialogues.text: (You find a fresh fruit pit in the pile of leaves.)

dialogues.speaker: Pile of Leaves
dialogues.text: (It seems like someone was here recently, but you can't find any more clues.)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Looks like we were too late.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This has gotta be where the newcomers rendezvous with whoever they're working for. But all the evidence has been destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Look at these ashes. Someone was burning documents not long before we arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could there be anything left? Maybe the wind could've blown the fire out before everything was finished burning?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The odds of that are very slim. It's practically impossible. I've checked — all the paper's been burned. There's only ash left now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we wait for them back at the Blackcliff Forge? They've gotta go back there sooner or later.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We can't count on that. Clearly, they were based here at one point, but it's mysteriously abandoned now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: To me, that says that whoever's behind this has moved them somewhere else to throw our investigation off course.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Darn... Guess this is where our trail runs cold!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Make no mistake, the purpose of our trip wasn't to find any solid evidence. We just need to figure out who's behind Zhiyi.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I smelled something peculiar the moment I came in.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Those newcomers probably thought they'd be safe as long as they burned the letters. But what they failed to consider is that paper and ink from different regions produce different odors when they're burned.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Really? *sniff* Paimon can't smell anything! Do you smell anything, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I smell a very gentle fragrance.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: There is a certain place with a freezing-cold climate where there's nothing but ice as far as the eye can see.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Some wealthy people there put floral fragrance in their ink as a way of injecting a little romance into their writing.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: When that fragrant ink is burned, this is the exact odor that it leaves behind...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Exactly. The evidence will soon be blown away by the wind, so it's nothing we can arrest anyone with.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But it's all I need. Now I know who we're dealing with, I can plan our next move.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You leave the abandoned house with Yelan...
Lady Yelan! Oh, thank goodness I finally found you! *sob* ...I thought I'd never see you again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Um, who are you?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Don't be alarmed, this is Wupei. He's Wenyuan and Shanghua's colleague.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I sent him to look into Zhiyi's regular contacts. Since Zhiyi likes fishing, Wupei thought he might know some of the fishermen and sailors, so he took a boat out to sea to ask around.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I left him a note at Yanshang Teahouse telling him to look for me at Blackcliff Forge when he got back. If there'd been an ambush waiting for us there, it means we'd have had some backup.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So, what did you find out at sea?

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: *sigh* Forgive my incompetence. I'm afraid I've come up empty-handed.

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: I asked all the fishermen multiple times, but none of them had had any interactions with Zhiyi before. Then the waves got so choppy I ended up falling overboard. Fortunately, someone managed to drag me out.

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: When I got back, I heard that you'd gone to Blackcliff Forge and might need backup, so I went straight there as fast as I could. Didn't even stop to change my clothes.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh? Well, Uncle Tian said that Zhiyi once bought a recipe from one of the fishermen. Did you hear anything about that at all?

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: What? That's news to me.

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: No, that's not possible... It's absolutely not possible! Lady Yelan, I'm telling you — I spoke to every single fisherman out there, and none of them mentioned anything about a recipe.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Interesting... Then I wonder how that "even more wonderful" fish soup came about?

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: Fish soup? What fish soup?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Nothing. Our priority right now is to find a way to get our hands on some solid evidence.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Well, any suggestions?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Not a bad idea. Wupei, what do you think?

response.speaker: Wupei
response.text: Honestly, I've already tried following Zhiyi. But the guy's too cautious. Never meets with anyone suspicious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, so tailing's out...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: No, we'll still need to tail him. But first, we need to do some groundwork.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Groundwork?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: When you've worked in intelligence for a long time, you'll understand that no one can stay on high alert forever. Especially... when he thinks he's about to win.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Tomorrow morning, I'll announce his victory at Yuehai Pavillion. Take a guess, what do you think he'll do next?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Be sure to arrive on time. You won't wanna miss the show.

choices.text: Catch them red-handed when they meet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Even though Yelan took half, this is still a lot to get through...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we gotta start somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Read Chapter: "Sea"

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: Due to a variety of factors, sea storms have become stronger in recent years.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: I suggest we set up a special patrol unit to deal with sea monsters. The fleet should consist of the following...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Covers various issues related to coastal defense...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Read Chapter: "Rock"

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: Much of Liyue's folklore suggests that Rex Lapis left a great deal of wealth in the mountains of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: However, due to obstacles hindering the excavation operation at The Chasm, many projects have been called off.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: The workers of the Blackcliff Forge have been idle near the Golden House for a long time now. They should be given first refusal if any suitable projects arise...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Covers mining, tunnel construction, and ruin exploration...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Read Chapter: "Roads"

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: The treacherous terrain around Huaguang Stone Forest and Qingyun Peak means the area has weak transport links.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: The sheer mountain peaks are connected only by rope bridges. They are dangerous to walk on and wholly unsuited to the transportation of goods.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: These areas are rich in medicinal herbs and ore deposits. Building a road network around the mountains would be beneficial for everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Covers plans to build roads and bridges.)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Made any discoveries?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not so far... But we're still looking!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What's the hurry? Don't get too close, or he'll see you.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This is the Blackcliff Forge.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let's look around for clues.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They went thataway! Hurry, we gotta catch up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... These footprints are heading towards Liyue Harbor. Maybe we were wrong about them?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Just as I thought. They didn't go to Liyue Harbor — they went that way.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Would you like to buy some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Get one for three hundred Mora, or three for a thousand.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Ah, another patron! Would you like to purchase some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: I promise that all my fish are fre—... No, super fresh!
